visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short hair and glasses, wearing a black button-down shirt, stands centrally against a night city backdrop featuring the Taipei 101 skyscraper. He speaks directly to the camera with expressive facial movements and points his finger upward to emphasize his initial hook. (2) A chromaticity diagram, a colorful triangular chart representing visible light, is overlaid on the screen beside the man. He gestures toward the diagram while explaining color perception. (3) The man continues his narration, his hand movements becoming more frequent as he adjusts his glasses. The background remains the sharp, brightly lit night skyline with high-rise buildings and neon lights. (4) A scientific graph showing the spectral sensitivity of S, M, and L cone cells appears. The man's upper body remains visible behind the semi-transparent graphic as he points to the overlapping curves. (5) The man is shown centrally again, explaining the 'Olo' color discovery. A large solid teal-green square briefly appears in front of his face as a visual placeholder for the mentioned color. (6) He concludes the video by pointing both hands downward toward a bottom banner. His expression is friendly and engaging, maintaining eye contact with the viewer.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 泛科學 NEWS. [Subtitle]: 你以為這張圖就是全部的顏色了. (2) [Slogan]: 驚！科學家發現全新顏色「Olo」. [Subtitle]: 別傻了. (3) [Subtitle]: 那只是大腦讓你看到的. (4) [Subtitle]: 有個顏色我敢說你絕對沒有看過. (5) [Subtitle]: 顏色大概長這樣. (6) [Subtitle]: 想了解更多科學新聞嗎. [Slogan]: 快留言許願 下週《泛科學NEWS》就來報！

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A professional male voice begins narrating with high energy and clear enunciation. The background music is a steady, upbeat electronic track with a prominent synthesized bassline and a tempo of approximately 124 BPM. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX sounds as the visual shifts to the chromaticity chart. The voice maintains a fast speech rate, delivering technical information with dynamic pitch variation. (3) A subtle digital 'click' or 'ding' UI sound effect punctuate the mention of specific scientific terms. The BGM continues smoothly without interruption. (4) The narrator's tone shifts to a more intrigued, lower-pitched register when introducing the 'Olo' color, followed by a slight swell in the BGM volume to build anticipation. (5) The audio concludes with a direct call to action; the vocal delivery becomes warmer and slower, perfectly synchronized with a final upbeat musical sting.
